topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Folk in this village talk of little else now but how Greymark has been hoarding gold like a miser. Who would have guessed, all these years, while we toil and worry over the price of seed, he sits there in a nest of riches? I can still hear the moan of his old plough, the poor thing, when he knew well enough he could afford the best. Saints above, for what do we pray and work if such secrets can be kept behind closed doors? The church bell tolls and all I can think is how hollow that sound is now, knowing what we know. A man might as well pray to his coins as to the heavens, it seems.
